findings.source_en: In return, the warlord only needed to agree to a few provisions. His neighbors to the north and the east would be granted land and titles. And the hordes would be pacified and made into their loyal subjects.
findings.ar: في المقابل، لم يكن على أمير الحرب سوى الموافقة على بضعة شروط. يُمنح جيرانه في الشمال والشرق أراضيَ وألقابًا، وتُهدَّأ الجحافل وتُجعَل من رعاياه الموالين.
findings.issue: 'their loyal subjects' is the neighbours' — plural 'their' against the warlord's singular 'his/he' two clauses earlier. The Arabic رعاياه makes the hordes the WARLORD's own subjects, which reverses the concession: the treaty's point is that he hands his horde over as subjects of the north and east, not that he keeps them.
findings.suggested_ar: في المقابل، لم يكن على أمير الحرب سوى الموافقة على بضعة شروط. يُمنح جيرانه في الشمال والشرق أراضيَ وألقابًا، وتُهدَّأ الجحافل وتُجعَل من رعاياهم الموالين.

findings.issue: 'Sigiled' means marked with sigils. المُختوم is the participle of ختم (stamping/sealing), which the glossary explicitly keeps away from the Seal mechanic (الخاتَم) — so this armour name reads as if it were Seal equipment rather than an engraved plate.
Frozen glossary term: Hierarch = الكاهن الأكبر (Smert's cult title). الحَبر الأعظم is the Catholic Supreme Pontiff and imports the wrong institution into the cult.
